New data set release: ICESat-2 Cal/Val 2022 L2 CHIR Green Wavelength Lidar Arctic Sea Ice Heights and Bathymetry, Version 1
ICESat-2 Cal/Val 2022 L2 CHIR Green Wavelength Lidar Arctic Sea Ice Heights and Bathymetry, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains Arctic summer sea ice heights and bathymetry with the primary purpose to evaluate the positional accuracies of NASA’s ICESat-2 ATLAS measurements.
User notice: AMSR2 products continued forward processing

The AMSR2 satellite-based data products, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), will continue forward processing, as the data remain available from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). NSIDC is planning for the development of AMSR3 data products in 2027, but AMSR2 data products will continue to be available until JAXA ends processing. NSIDC is planning to develop AMSR3 data products in the future.
The NSIDC AMSR2 satellite-based data products include:

User notice: SMAP data reprocessing
SMAP Standard and Near Real-Time

data sets, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), experienced a geolocation issue from 14 May 2026 to 28 July 2026. All Standard products for that time period are currently being reprocessed and will be replaced in the coming weeks. Near Real-Time products will not be replaced.
Data set update: DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS Daily Polar Gridded Brightness Temperatures, Version 6
DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS Daily Polar Gridded Brightness Temperatures, Version 6

data set, accessible through the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), has been updated through 5 July 2026. This data set provides daily gridded brightness temperatures derived from passive microwave sensors and distributed in a polar stereographic projection.
New data set release: ICESat-2 Calibration/Validation LVIS L3A Sea Ice Freeboard, Version 1
ICESat-2 Calibration/Validation LVIS L3A Sea Ice Freeboard, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains high-resolution sea ice freeboard estimates derived from airborne measurements collected over the Arctic Ocean.

New data set release: High Mountain Asia MODIS/Terra L3 Daily 500m SIN Grid Spatially and Temporally Complete (STC) Snow Cover and Snow Surface Properties, Version 1
High Mountain Asia MODIS/Terra L3 Daily 500m SIN Grid Spatially and Temporally Complete (STC) Snow Cover and Snow Surface Properties, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains spatially and temporally complete (STC) raster images of snow cover and snow surface properties from 1 October 2000 through 30 June 2022 for the High Mountain Asia region.
New data set release: SnowEx23 Airborne SWESARR Backscatter Intensity Raw, Version 1
SnowEx23 Airborne SWESARR Backscatter Intensity Raw, Version 1

data set is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains raw airborne microwave observations from the Goddard Space Flight Center Snow Water Equivalent Synthetic Aperture Radar and Radiometer instrument collected during the SnowEx 2023 field campaign in Alaska. Available data include measured complex backscatter in both in-phase and quadrature binary format.
Data set update: MEaSUREs Greenland 6 and 12 day Ice Sheet Velocity Mosaics from SAR, Version 2
MEaSUREs Greenland 6 and 12 day Ice Sheet Velocity Mosaics from SAR, Version 2

data set, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), has been updated. Sentinel-1C data has been added, and the temporal coverage has been extended to 27 December 2025. Also note: Changes in cloud storage protocols necessitated a minor change to the file naming convention.
New data set release: SnowEx23 Oct23 IOP Snow Pits and Substrate Conditions at Freeze Up, Version 1
SnowEx23 Oct23 IOP Snow Pits and Substrate Conditions at Freeze Up, Version 1

data set is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set presents snow pit measurements collected during the NASA SnowEx October 2023 Intensive Observation Period in Alaska, USA. Three study areas represented boreal forest snow near Fairbanks, AK: Farmers Loop Creamers Field, Caribou Poker Creek Research Watershed, and Bonanza Creek Experimental Forest.
New data set release: RapidScat Twice-Daily SIR-Enhanced EASE-Grid 2.0 Radar Backscatter, Version 1
RapidScat Twice-Daily SIR-Enhanced EASE-Grid 2.0 Radar Backscatter, Version 1

data set is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set provides Ku-band radar backscatter measurements of Sigma Nought (σ⁰, Sigma0) collected by RapidScat’s SeaWinds scatterometer flown aboard the International Space Station between October 2014 and August 2016.
